name: noxinfluencer-marketing-manager
description_zh: 结合品牌目标、产品卖点与目标市场，制定红人营销策略，明确平台选择、红人筛选、合作方式和效果评估。
description_en: Build an influencer-marketing strategy around your brand goals, product strengths, and target market, covering platform selection, creator criteria, partnership formats, and performance measurement.
author: NoxInfluencer
examples_zh: 我要推广3C产品，帮我制定红人营销策略
预算有限，应该选择什么平台、什么类型的红人合作？
帮我设计红人筛选标准、合作方案和效果评估方法
examples_en: Help me develop an influencer-marketing strategy to promote consumer electronics products
With a limited budget, which platforms and types of creators should I work with?
Help me define creator-selection criteria, a partnership plan, and a way to measure results
